text: Private notes: sensitive details on an idea live outside git (gitignored store or linked file), and the MCP warns before writing them to tracked fields
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23 in Felix's life graph: preparing human steps (tax office letter, health insurance, phone contract) naturally produces details like tax numbers, insurance numbers, phone numbers and addresses. A status comment containing the tax number was blocked by Claude Code's safety classifier, because .bowman is committed to git. The workaround was to put the draft in a non-git docs/ folder and reference the path. That works, but it's ad hoc and the graph can't show the content.

Proposal: an idea can carry a private note stored in .bowman/runtime/ (gitignored, machine-local) or a linked file path outside the repo. The UI shows it with a lock, and the MCP exposes it as a separate field. Optionally, update_idea warns when tracked fields match common secret/PII patterns (IBAN, tax IDs, phone numbers) and suggests the private field.

Refuted if personal graphs stay rare or users accept everything in git.

status.comment: Felix 2026-11-23: out of scope for now. Private details need a safer server, and "I trust GitHub" for the graph as it is.
